sections.heading: Situation
sections.text: Holmström Fastigheter Holding AB (publ) is an unlisted bond issuer. [S1] It has a SEK 500m senior secured bond, ISIN SE0015797667, with maturity of 14 April 2028 after amendment. [S2] A written procedure launched on 6 July 2026 proposed extending maturity by 18 months and winding down group assets. [S3] Property value was SEK 642m and cash was SEK 24m at 30 June 2026. [S5]

sections.heading: Why now
sections.text: Bondholders approved the written procedure on 23 July 2026, with a 61.75% quorum and 100% in favour. [S4] The approved plan includes a wind-down of group assets, so disposals appear to be the intended route to repayment. [S3] On 1 October 2026 the bond agent approved moving the Vincero divestment completion to 15 December 2026. [S6] The same approval moved bond redemption to 8 January 2027. [S6]

sections.heading: Refinancing and covenants
sections.text: The bond is senior secured and the issuer has already needed one bondholder consent process. [S2][S4] Based on the SEK 642m property value, SEK 500m of debt implies a gross loan-to-value of about 78%, assuming the full amount is outstanding, which needs to be confirmed. [S2][S5] Cash of SEK 24m is small against the bond size. [S2][S5] The covenant terms, any amendment fees or margin changes, and the amortisation schedule are not in the facts provided and should be checked in the amended terms. [S3]

sections.heading: Possible transaction
sections.text: The wind-down mandate suggests that portfolio or single-asset purchases from the group could be available. [S3] The Vincero divestment is the one identified disposal, and its terms and buyer are not provided. [S6] Any bid for other assets would need to cover the secured bond, so the security package and release mechanics should be reviewed. [S2][S3]

sections.heading: Risks and open questions
sections.text: The sources give two different end dates: 14 April 2028 after amendment and bond redemption on 8 January 2027. [S2][S6] We should check whether the January 2027 date is an early redemption tied to the Vincero proceeds or a change to the maturity. [S2][S6] The Vincero divestment completion has already been extended once, so execution risk on disposals is evident. [S6] The property value is as of 30 June 2026, and we should check who prepared the valuation and when. [S5] The Vincero asset's share of the SEK 642m is not stated. [S5][S6]

sections.heading: Next steps
sections.text: Obtain the written procedure documents and the amended bond terms to confirm maturity, redemption mechanics, covenants and security. [S2][S3][S4] Obtain the Q2 2026 interim report in full and build an asset-level schedule from it. [S5] Ask the bond agent for the status and terms of the Vincero divestment and for the latest completion timetable. [S6] Then decide whether to approach the issuer. [S1]
